decision_explanations.formula_text: Strategy branch emitted by backend runtime projection; no frontend branch derivation.
TFIS scans actual listed contracts for the allowed expiry set, filters them by option side, strike search range, OI, and premium thresholds, then freezes one final contract for the strategy instance.

Base entry, target, and stop-loss are produced by the backend plan packet. Where available, TFIS also records the raw workbook output before tick normalization and the normalized trading prices shown to the operator.
ORPT, RC, and runtime entry-eligibility state emitted by backend runtime projection.
Order and PositionCycle state emitted by backend runtime projection.
